crossRefs.note: Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God; for I pray to you.
Yahweh, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch…
At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you, because of your righteous ordinances.
I rise before dawn and cry for help. I put my hope in your words.
My eyes stay open through the night watches, that I might meditate on your word.
When Daniel knew that the writing was signed, he went into his house (now his windows were open in his room toward…
Then they answered and said before the king, “That Daniel, who is of the children of the captivity of Judah, doesn’t…
Early in the morning, while it was still dark, he rose up and went out, and departed into a deserted place, and prayed…
After he had taken leave of them, he went up the mountain to pray.
Seeing them distressed in rowing, for the wind was contrary to them, about the fourth watch of the night he came to…
He also spoke a parable to them that they must always pray, and not give up,
Peter and John were going up into the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour.
At about the ninth hour of the day, he clearly saw in a vision an angel of God coming to him, and saying to him…
Now on the next day as they were on their journey, and got close to the city, Peter went up on the housetop to pray at…
Cornelius said, “Four days ago, I was fasting until this hour, and at the ninth hour, I prayed in my house, and behold…
with all prayer and requests, praying at all times in the Spirit, and being watchful to this end in all perseverance…
Pray without ceasing.
“Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard. I cry for help, but there is no justice.
Yes, when I cry, and call for help, he shuts out my prayer.
He, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able…

translations.web: Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.
translations.bsb: Morning, noon, and night, I cry out in distress, and He hears my voice.
translations.kjv: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.
translations.asv: Evening, and morning, and at noonday, will I complain, and moan; And he will hear my voice.
